items.body:
**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Shell-quote status contexts in evidence commands**

When a null-target commit status has a context containing a single quote, `scripts/pr-feedback.py` copies that external value into `check`, but `json.dumps` only protects jq syntax—not the surrounding shell single quotes. The generated evidence command can therefore terminate the jq argument and execute trailing shell commands when replayed through `bash -c`, or at minimum become unreplayable. Avoid interpolating `check` into shell code, for example by selecting this item by index or passing a safely shell-quoted `--arg`; the task's residual input control merely enumerates binaries and does not mitigate this injection path.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L78-L78](https://github.com/mryfmo/dotfiles/blob/3657d672f7a66e8916772b597ff8d653fa48bdd5/AGENTS.md#L78-L78)

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
